$comment: Pin for the two thunder sidecars this app ships (thunder-daemon, thunder-std).
They are built in the thunder repository; this file is how this repository knows
which build it has, without reading a thunder checkout.
The two must travel together: the daemon discovers `thunder-std` next to its own
binary and silently runs with no tools at all when it cannot.
artifacts is keyed by <platform>-<arch> and then by file name, each entry
carrying the sha256 of the exact file. scripts/prepare-sidecars.mjs refuses a
cached binary whose hash does not match, and scripts/fetch-thunder-binaries.mjs
refuses a download that does. Run that script with --bless to (re)fill this file.
An empty artifacts map means no cache has been blessed yet: the build then
`source` is null on purpose: no thunder release carries this commit yet (main is
67+ commits past v0.6.0 and has no release workflow). `--from-release` therefore
demands an explicit --source, which is the honest thing for it to do rather than
silently downloading a v0.6.0 build that has a different crate layout.
